Under the European Convention on Human Rights, a state may not derogate from the ban on slavery, as stated in Article 4 of the Convention. The ban on slavery and forced labour specifies that:

1. No one shall be held in slavery or servitude.
2. No one shall be required to perform forced or compulsory labour.

The provisions of this Article are absolute and cannot be derogated from, even in times of war or emergency.
